title: Sum formulas
text: The sum of i from $$1$$ to $$n$$ is $$\frac{n\left(n+1\right)}{2}$$, and the sum of $$i^2$$ from $$1$$ to $$n$$ is $$\frac{n\left(n+1\right) \left(2n+1\right)}{6}$$.

title: Evaluate each piece
text: Rewrite $$\left(2k\right)^2$$ as $$4k^2$$. With $$n=25$$: $$4$$ times the sum of $$k^2$$ is $$4\times5525=22100$$, and $$100$$ times the sum of k is $$100\times325=32500$$. So the sum is $$22100-32500=-10400$$.
